title: dryopteris intermedia subsp. azorica
intro: Dryopteris intermedia subsp. azorica, commonly known as Azores Scaly Male Fern, is a type of plant belonging to the Dryopteris genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Azores Scaly Male Fern include its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to remove excess fluids from the body, and its potential to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
